heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of Commerce $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 1980, 1981, and 1982 and $1,500,000 for each of the fiscal years 1985 through 1988 to carry out the purposes of this subchapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1984—Pub. L. 98–616 authorized appropriation of $1,500,000 for each of fiscal years 1985 through 1988.

ancestors.heading: DUTIES OF SECRETARY OF COMMERCE IN RESOURCE AND RECOVERY
